title: Brand new! Heated Pool | Game Room | Golf | Arcade
description:
Your Gilbert getaway awaits—ideal for family vacations, group trips, or a fun staycation.

Relax in the heated pool and hot tub, or challenge friends in the game room. Mornings start with coffee outside, and evenings end with sunset swims and laughter—your own private escape.

 The space 
✅ Sleeps up to 16 | 5 Bedrooms + 2 Game Rooms | 4.5 Bathrooms

Here for a wedding, sports tournament, or family getaway? This spacious Gilbert home is designed with comfort and connection in mind. With room for the whole crew and endless amenities, everyone—from toddlers to grandparents—will feel right at home.

What guests rave about:
✔ Resort-style backyard with heated pool, hot tub, putting green, fire pit, cornhole & outdoor grill station
✔ Two game rooms featuring pool table, arcades, Nintendo Switch 2, shuffleboard & darts
✔ Fully stocked kitchen ideal for big group meals
✔ Reliable Wi-Fi throughout the home
✔ Host-level service with clear, fast communication
✔ Quiet neighborhood that’s walkable, bike-friendly & minutes from top dining, shopping & attractions

Sleep Setup:
🛏️ Bedroom 1 (Primary): King bed + ensuite bath
🛏️ Bedroom 2: Queen bed + ensuite bath
🛏️ Bedroom 3: Queen bed bunkbeds 
🛏️ Bedroom 4: 2 twin bunkbeds (sleeps 4)
🛏️ Bedroom 5: Queen bed + ensuite bath
🕹️ Kids Game Room: Queen sleeper + multiple air mattresses available upon request

Perfect for:
• Multi-generational family trips & reunions
• Wedding parties & celebrations
• Sports tournaments, golf getaways & retreats
• Locals planning the ultimate staycation

Explore the area: You’re minutes from Topgolf, SanTan Village, Downtown Gilbert, and Gilbert Regional Park, with endless restaurants, shopping, and outdoor adventures nearby.

📍 Bonus: Just 25 minutes from Sky Harbor Airport!

Your hosts are known for thoughtful details, smooth check-ins, and quick support. Whether you’re gathering with family or celebrating with friends, this is your go-to Gilbert retreat.

 Guest access 
The house is exclusively yours, without interruption during your stay, so relax, unwind, and make yourself at home.

Other than the already mentioned amenities, our home is also equipped with:

✔ High-Speed Wi-Fi 
✔ Air Conditioning
✔ Heating
✔ Iron/Board
✔ Washer/Dryer
✔ Free Parking

 Other things to note 
★ NO PETS ALLOWED ★
We love those little (and not so little) furry bundles of joy. Sadly, our home is not suitable to accommodate them.

★ NO SMOKING INSIDE ★
Please refrain from smoking inside the home! Any smoking evidence will result in odor removal and furniture cleaning fees.

★ NO PARTIES/EVENTS ★
We kindly ask you to treat our home as your own to preserve its pristine condition for future guests and your return visits.

Thank you very much for your understanding.
